name: Asahi Kasei Plastics North America
old_description: Introducing Asahi Kasei's engineering plastic products, their features, and examples of applications in a variety of fields.
about:
Asahi Kasei Plastics North America operates from Fowlerville, Michigan, as the North American arm of Japan’s Asahi Kasei Corporation. The subsidiary was established to bring the parent company’s portfolio of engineering plastics and technical services to the U.S. market, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The company supplies a range of high-performance resins including polyamide (LEONA™), polyacetal (TENAC™), modified polyphenylene ether (XYRON™), polypropylene compounds, engineering particle foam, continuous fiber-reinforced thermoplastics (CFRTP), cellulose nanofiber (CNF) nanocomposites, and the ASACLEAN® purging compound. Beyond material supply, it offers CAE analysis services — featuring topology optimization and molding simulation — and provides technical support covering material selection, molding conditions, and powder injection molding (PIM) binder systems from design through mass production.

Its customer base spans automotive, where materials are used in millimeter-wave radar antennas and EV battery peripherals; AI data centers, for power connectors, cooling pumps, and server fans; medical devices, with POM grades meeting ISO 10993-5 and USP Class VI; and photovoltaic installations, supplying connector and junction-box components. The division was recognized by DENSO with a 2026 North America Business Partner Award, underscoring its role in automotive supply chains.

Asahi Kasei emphasizes customized material solutions backed by simulation-driven design, aiming to reduce weight, improve heat resistance, and meet flame-retardancy requirements. The group also highlights its commitment to carbon neutrality and circular economy initiatives across the engineering plastics business.

name: Ascend Medical LLC
old_description: Ascend Medical was founded in 2014 with a goal to help the Treasure Valley have access to more orthopedic, sport bracing, and post op recovery resources. We are have expanded our company to work alongside physicians in Idaho and Utah.
about:
Ascend Medical LLC was established in 2014 in Boise, Idaho, with the aim of giving the Treasure Valley broader access to orthopedic, sport bracing, and post-operative recovery resources. The company began as a local supplier focused on patient needs and has since extended its reach to collaborate with physicians across Idaho and Utah.

The firm supplies a range of medical products including orthopedic bracing, sport bracing, wound-care items, and biologics, positioning itself as a resource for post-surgical and injury recovery. It operates from a facility on West Emerald Street in Boise, though specific headcount, facility size, and volume metrics are not disclosed.

Ascend Medical serves healthcare providers, working directly with physicians in Idaho and Utah and, in recent years, with Veterans Affairs communities. Its customer base includes clinics, hospitals, and VA facilities seeking recovery-focused products.

The company states that patient care is its top priority and that it differentiates itself by offering cutting-edge, innovative products designed to help patients recover faster from injury and surgery. This mission drove its founding and continues to guide its expansion.

about:
Aspects Furniture International, Inc. operates from Chino Hills, California. The company traces its roots back more than 40 years, building a reputation for custom furniture manufacturing.

The firm specializes in design, engineering, and manufacturing of custom casegoods, upholstered seating, vanities, and metal furniture. Its engineers translate concepts into AutoCAD drawings, and craftsmen produce the pieces in-house. No facility size or headcount is disclosed.

Aspects serves the hospitality and commercial interior design sectors. Notable projects include custom furniture for the Hoodoo Moab hotel, a Curio Collection by Hilton property in Moab, Utah, and the Inn at Saratoga, both developed in partnership with design firm Atwater Inc.

The company emphasizes simplifying and streamlining the manufacturing process to deliver on time and to the highest quality standards, positioning itself as a partner that builds the client's vision from concept to completion.

name: Aspen Electronics Manufacturing Inc.
old_description: Many companies claim it, yet we live by it. At each stage of product delivery, we stand by our word.
about:
Aspen Electronics Manufacturing Inc. is based in Westminster, Colorado. The company has grown responsibly for 26 consecutive years. Ownership details and founders are not publicly disclosed. It began as an engineering-driven operation focused on detail and customer commitment.

The company provides electronic manufacturing services including surface-mount and through-hole PCB assembly, component sourcing, prototyping, and functional testing. Its capabilities span from hand placement of leaded components to automated machine placement of fine-pitch parts and BGAs, accommodating board sizes from small to large with mixed through-hole and single- or double-sided SMT. Additional services include in-circuit testing, full unit build, and cable and harness assembly. Quality processes feature automated optical inspection (AOI) on all boards after reflow, with optical character recognition on SMT components, and inspection to IPC-A-610 Class II (Class III available).

Aspen Electronics serves customers in the defense sector, evidenced by its ITAR registration with the U.S. Department of Defense, as well as broader electronics manufacturers requiring PCB assembly and test. Clients engage directly with an engineering-background manager from the first interaction, eliminating internal translation of technical requirements.

The company emphasizes lean manufacturing integrated throughout production, targeting a defect rate near zero through thorough functional testing. It promotes fair pricing supported by supplier relationships and commits to on-time delivery, with staff often working overtime to meet deadlines.

name: Assembled Products, Inc.
old_description: Specializing in Prototypes, Small to Medium Production Electronics Assembly  and Manufacutring since 1986
about:
Assembled Products, Inc. was founded in 1986 by Michael Stevens in Collierville, Tennessee, before relocating to Piperton, Tennessee in 1990 and later to a 33,000‑square‑foot facility in the Elgin community near Rogersville, Alabama. The company is woman‑owned and operates as a small business with approximately ten employees.

The shop provides printed circuit board assembly (PCBA) using surface‑mount, through‑hole, and mixed‑technology processes, along with electromechanical box builds, wire‑harness fabrication, conformal coating, and functional testing. In‑house capabilities extend to design‑for‑manufacturability review, repair and rework, 3D printing, CAD drawing, patent research, and new‑product consulting. The facility also houses machining, plastic molding, and urethane/resin casting equipment to support complete product development from prototype through low‑to‑medium‑volume production.

Customers span military electronics upgrades, custom electronics, and general industrial electronics. Named accounts have included Federal Express, AutoZone, the University of Memphis, Hypertech, and IBS, alongside individual inventors and hobbyists. The company serves the southeastern United States — Alabama, Tennessee, Mississippi, Georgia, and Florida — as well as national clients.

Assembled Products positions itself on quality over low‑cost offshore alternatives, emphasizing quick response times, transparent communication, and U.S.‑based manufacturing leveraging Alabama’s low labor and tax rates. The founder started the business after his previous employer declined small jobs, a focus that remains central to the operation.

old_description: I graduated from Northern Illinois University with a bachelor’s degree in Communications. I’m happily married to my beautiful wife since 2009 and am a father of two girls. I look forward to taking my girls on adventures and making them smile. My family and friends come first and I am willing do anything for them no matter what. In my free time enjoy golfing, gaming, biking, and building stuff with my hands.
about:
Assemblies Unlimited, Inc. was founded in 1993 by Randy Shaw in Bloomingdale, Illinois. Shaw, a Northern Illinois University graduate with a background in industrial packaging sales at firms like Illinois Tool Works and Molex, started the company to build a national network of contract packaging vendors (co-packers) for food and non-food applications. The privately held company maintains its corporate headquarters in Bloomingdale with regional sales offices in Irvine, California, and Garden City, New York.

The company provides turnkey contract packaging and fulfillment services across more than 20 plant locations nationwide. Capabilities span primary and secondary packaging for both food and non-food products, including liquid and dry filling (bottles, pouches, VFFS, HFFS), hand assembly, bindery, repackaging, labeling, blister packaging, bundling, shrink wrapping, kitting, and clean-room operations. Several facilities are certified to 21 CFR Part 111 for pharmaceutical (RX/OTC) packaging and to SQF Level 3 for food safety. The Reno, Nevada site alone offers over 300,000 square feet of warehousing. Typical production runs start at a minimum of 25,000 units per SKU.

Assemblies Unlimited serves a broad range of industries: food and beverage (snacks, confectionery, nuts, gummies, protein powders, seasonings), pharmaceuticals and nutraceuticals (RX/OTC drugs, supplements), household and automotive chemicals (adhesives, car care), and general retail. Customers range from large consumer packaged goods (CPG) corporations to emerging startups launching their first product.

The firm emphasizes three differentiators: quick turnaround through streamlined processes, seamless project management that covers sourcing, inventory control, and logistics, and a responsive customer experience backed by three decades of hands-on expertise across thousands of retail packaging projects.

name: Assembly Solutions
old_description: , we’ve delivered fast turnaround, cost-effective solutions, and reliable results.
about:
Assembly Solutions was founded in 2001 by four entrepreneurs in an incubator facility in St. Charles, Missouri. The company now operates from Bridgeton, Missouri, where it has grown into a full-service electronic contract manufacturer.

The company specializes in printed circuit board assemblies using both through-hole and surface-mount technology, custom cable and harness assemblies, and complete electromechanical box builds. It provides turnkey services that span engineering design, materials procurement, manufacturing, testing, and quality assurance, all under one roof. The facility is described as state-of-the-art, though its square footage and headcount are not disclosed.

Assembly Solutions serves original equipment manufacturers across agriculture, aviation, construction and mining, general manufacturing, medical devices, LED lighting and chargers, video and surveillance, and industrial controllers. Customers cite long-term partnerships, with one relationship spanning 18 years, and highlight the firm's ability to handle both prototype runs and high-volume production.

The founders started the business after recognizing a growing demand for reliable contract manufacturing in the region. The company emphasizes shorter lead times, cost-effective pricing, seamless communication, scalable production, and end-to-end support.

name: Astro Sheet Metal Co., Inc.
old_description: Astro is a family-owned custom metal fabrication company founded in 1967 in Irving, Texas.
about:
Astro Sheet Metal Co., Inc. is a family-owned custom metal fabrication company founded in 1967 in Irving, Texas. Now headquartered in Grand Prairie, Texas, the company has operated for over five decades under family ownership.

The shop provides architectural and industrial metal solutions, handling projects from design assistance and submittal drawings through mockup fabrication, brake forming of metal up to 14 feet long, welding, cutting, and final installation. It serves general contractors and subcontractors with architectural metal scopes for bar areas, ceilings, elevator entries, and reception areas, while also supplying custom fittings, hoppers, platforms, and transitions for food-service and plant-maintenance clients. Rush delivery is offered throughout the Dallas/Fort Worth and Austin regions.

Astro's project portfolio spans healthcare (OU Medical Center, Texas Health Resources), hospitality (Bowie House Hotel, Hall Park Hotel), entertainment (Meow Wolf), education (College Station City Hall), government, commercial real estate (AMLI Fountain Place, Granite Park), and retail (Crocs Storefront). Its customers include designers, builders, general contractors, and subcontractors across Texas and Oklahoma.

The company emphasizes rapid turnaround times and a single-source approach from consulting to installation, a model shaped by its founding focus on precision and speed. Family ownership and over 50 years of experience are cited as foundations for its reliability in delivering complex architectural metalwork on schedule.

name: Atelier Amelia
old_description: Atelier Amelia is a New York-based garment manufacturer providing full-service support to established and emerging designer labels. Our team of experts offers comprehensive solutions, including sample development, pattern making, marking, grading, tech pack creation, production, and fitting services. We understand that each client is unique, and we work with them to create a customized approach that meets their specific needs and requirements.
about:
Atelier Amelia was founded in 2016 by designer Zhu Ru Chen in New York City. After struggling to find reliable manufacturers for her own swimwear line, Chen established the company to provide emerging brands with high-quality production and a personal touch.

The company operates a full-service sample room and production factory in New York, offering sample development, pattern making, marking, grading, tech pack creation, garment production, fitting services, sourcing, and technical specifications. Its in-house facility can produce 3,000 to 5,000 pieces per month while accommodating smaller runs with flexible quantities.

Atelier Amelia serves established and emerging designer labels across apparel and fashion categories. Clients include brands like Maiden Name, whose co-founder Alix Freireich has worked with the factory since 2019. The company focuses on designers launching their own lines, often investing personal capital.

The founder’s firsthand experience drives the company’s emphasis on quality, precision, and seamless collaboration. Atelier Amelia champions Made-in-NY manufacturing, supports emerging talent, and is integrating 3D fitting technology to reduce cost and lead time.
